map.混合水量 = 同时洗澡人数 × 淋浴时长 × 花洒流量；热水占比 =（目标水温: Mixed water = simultaneous showers × shower minutes × shower flow; hot fraction = (target temperature − inlet temperature) ÷ (tank temperature − inlet temperature); 60°C hot water = mixed water × hot fraction; storage capacity = 60°C hot water ÷ usable fraction (default 80%); gas rating is normalized to a 25°C rise; instantaneous power = shower flow × 4.186 × temperature rise ÷ 60.

map.储水式容量按 60°C 热水与 80% 可用率估算；实际可用热水受内胆结构、进水: Storage capacity assumes 60°C water and 80% usable volume; actual usable hot water depends on tank design, inlet temperature, mixing valve and insulation, so go one size up in winter.
map.燃气升数是温升 25°C 的额定流量，不是实际每分钟出水量；冬季进水 5°C、目: Gas ratings are at a 25°C rise, not actual outlet flow; with 5°C inlet and 40°C target the rise is 35°C, so actual flow is roughly rated × 25 ÷ 35.

Two 10-minute showers at 8 L/min need about 160 L mixed water at 40°C, about 89 L of 60°C water, and about 111 L tank volume at 80% usable, so choose 120 L or stagger users with an 80 L tank.
map.燃气热水器看「升数」时要记住它按温升 25°C 标定。冬季进水 5°C、目标 4: Gas ratings assume a 25°C rise. With 5°C inlet and 40°C target the rise is 35°C, so a 16 L/min unit delivers only about 11.4 L/min; two simultaneous showers need a larger rating based on total flow.
map.即热式电热水器的核心不是容量而是功率与电路。8 L/min、温升 25°C 约需: For instantaneous electric units, power and wiring matter more than capacity. 8 L/min at a 25°C rise needs about 14 kW, roughly 63 A at 220 V, usually an 80 A breaker and 10 mm² dedicated line; when service capacity is limited, storage or gas is often more practical.

map.差在温升 25°C 时的额定流量。单卫 8 L/min 淋浴 12 L 足够；双: The difference is rated flow at a 25°C rise. A single 8 L/min shower is fine at 12 L; two simultaneous showers or very cold winter inlet favor 16 L+.
map.即热式一定要改电吗？: Does an instantaneous heater always require electrical work?
map.多数情况要。8 L/min 淋浴约 14 kW，普通 16 A 插座带不动；需独: Usually yes. An 8 L/min shower needs about 14 kW, beyond a standard 16 A socket; it needs a dedicated line and breaker, with an electrician checking service capacity and wire size.
map.容量越大越费电吗？: Does a larger tank use more electricity?
map.加热同样水量所需能量接近，大容量主要增加保温散热与占地。按人数选合适容量，比盲目: Heating the same water takes similar energy; a larger tank mainly adds standby loss and footprint. Sizing to the household saves more than upsizing blindly.
